cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a cheese shop — a glass counter of cheese wheels, wooden shelves, a cheese wire and a small tasting table
cuts.scene: she is the shop manager slicing a wheel of cheese with the cheese wire at the counter
cuts.outfit: a cheesemonger look fitted to her body — a short striped apron over a fitted camisole and short skirt, bare shoulders and legs, a golden wire-cutter hanging at her waist
